name: sudoers-rule
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: drops a raw sudoers rule into /etc/sudoers.d (validated with visudo -c so it never bricks sudo). Use for GTFObin-style NOPASSWD grants or a Defaults line. Vars: DROPIN_NAME (required, basename in /etc/sudoers.d); RULE (required, one sudoers line).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
: "${DROPIN_NAME:?DROPIN_NAME is required}"
: "${RULE:?RULE is required}"
f="/etc/sudoers.d/$DROPIN_NAME"
printf '%s\n' "$RULE" > "$f"
chmod 0440 "$f"
visudo -cf "$f" >/dev/null
